name: Amangani
insider_take: Perched dramatically atop East Gros Ventre Butte, Amangani is where rugged Wyoming wilderness meets serene, understated luxury — a sanctuary that feels as timeless as the Tetons themselves.
whats_special: Amangani — meaning "peaceful home" in Sanskrit — lives up to its name at every turn. Sitting at 7,000 feet elevation, this intimate Aman property features just 40 suites clad in warm redwood and Oklahoma sandstone, all designed to frame sweeping views of the Snake River Valley and the iconic Grand Teton peaks. The resort seamlessly blends into its natural surroundings, offering one of the most visually dramatic settings of any hotel in North America. In winter, ski-in/ski-out access to Snow King Mountain Resort is steps away, while summer brings world-class hiking, fly fishing, and wildlife watching in neighboring Grand Teton National Park and Yellowstone.
pro_tip: Book a suite on the upper floors for unobstructed, panoramic views of the Teton Range — especially magical at golden hour when the peaks glow amber. If you visit in winter, ask the concierge about private snowshoe excursions guided through the butte at dusk.
dont_miss: The Amangani Pool is a year-round highlight — an outdoor heated pool and hot tub that feels suspended over the valley below. Dining at the Grill is equally unforgettable, showcasing locally sourced Wyoming ingredients with mountain views as your backdrop. And just 12 miles away, the charming town of Jackson offers world-renowned galleries, the famous antler arches of Town Square, and a lively après-ski scene worth exploring.
pros: Stunning panoramic views of Jackson Hole valley and Grand Teton mountains
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with mountain-inspired treatments
Prime location for world-class skiing and outdoor adventures
Signature Aman minimalist luxury design and impeccable service standards
cons: Remote mountain location requires planning for dining and activities
